_why: Large terminal frames can exceed the pipe buffer. Under the wrapper's global pipefail, grep -q exits on an early match, the upstream printf takes SIGPIPE, and each wait gate reads a match as a non-match. Each mutation restores one pipeline independently and is pinned to the regression node for that gate.
_sweep:
Repo-wide sweep of `<producer> | grep -q` and `<producer> | head` under the wrapper's global pipefail, first run 2026-09-01 and REWRITTEN the same day after two of its rule-outs were falsified by measurement. Rule-outs below are stated on the property that was actually measured; the earlier version argued from output size alone, which is unsound for an external producer. History is in git and in the two newer specs' _provenance.

FIXED (grep -q class, three sites, all had an unbounded input): the two wait frame gates in this spec; the agy verdict-recovery predicate (mutation-specs/agy_recovery_sigpipe.json); the cmux aliveness gate (mutation-specs/cmux_alive_sigpipe.json).

RULED OUT -- `| head -1` over jq (:84 :469 :912 :1370 :1753 :1759). The property is CARDINALITY, not size: every one selects on a key that is unique by construction (.handle, .id, .paneKey, tabId:leafId, leafId), so the producer has nothing left to write when head exits. Measured threshold with a pathological all-duplicate fixture: 1000 matching lines (12 KB) still rc 0, 5000 (60 KB) rc 141 -- inversion needs some thousands of matching lines. Measured on a live install (n=1): terminals=7, max multiplicity 1 for handle, leafId and tabId:leafId; agents=3, max multiplicity 1 for paneKey. Uniqueness-by-construction is the load-bearing half; the live count is corroboration.

RULED OUT -- `| head -n 1` over grep on the preflight receipt (:256 :258 :264). _receipt_write TRUNCATES (`> "$rf"`) and writes exactly three fixed lines, so each pattern matches once. Caveat, documented rather than defended: HMAD_PREFLIGHT_RECEIPT_FILE lets a caller point these at an arbitrary file, and a large file with thousands of matching lines would abort the wrapper -- a config surface, not a reachable defect path.

RULED OUT -- :2906 :2967 (pane-slot predicates) and :1644 (worktree-rm error excerpt). The property is that the VALUE is small -- the live-handle list is a few dozen handles, the orca error envelope a short string -- and for :1644 the rc is discarded. Note it is NOT that printf is a builtin: the fixed :2647 site was builtin printf and inverted at 240 KB.

mutations.name: not-while-large-match-uses-pipe
mutations._mechanism: Restore printf | grep -q only on the negative gate. A large frame carrying the busy marker then fails open because pipefail reports printf's SIGPIPE instead of grep's match.

mutations.name: until-large-match-uses-pipe
mutations._mechanism: Restore printf | grep -q only on the positive gate. A large frame carrying required evidence then fails closed because pipefail reports printf's SIGPIPE instead of grep's match.
